Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.audioplayer

Class Playlist

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.audioplayer.Playlist
public class Playlist extends Object
The audio player's ordered library and playback cursor: an AWT-free model of "what plays next". All of the ordering logic (sequential advance, wrap-around under repeat, random selection under shuffle) lives here so it is unit-testable without a sound device or a display; the panel simply reflects this state.

Shuffle draws from an injected Random, so a test can seed it and assert a deterministic order. The current index is -1 when nothing is selected.

    • next

      public MediaItem next()
      Advances to the next item and returns it. Under shuffle a different random index is chosen; otherwise the cursor moves forward one, wrapping to the start only when isRepeat() is set.
      Returns:
      the next item, or null at the end of a non-repeating playlist

    • previous

      public MediaItem previous()
      Steps back to the previous item and returns it, wrapping to the end only when isRepeat() is set. Shuffle steps back sequentially (a random "previous" is meaningless).
      Returns:
      the previous item, or null at the start of a non-repeating list
